title: The Logical answer to the puzzle
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：logical　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 logical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the postman wrote of ① a logical answer to the puzzle in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so logical that nobody in the office would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the logical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the logical answer to the puzzle that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for June 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too logical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the logical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a logical reason for the rule, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as logical as the reason for the rule they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was logical or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something logical, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite logical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the logical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, in silence, she wrote of another logical answer to the puzzle in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less logical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The logical reason for the rule that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the logical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 合乎逻辑（前置定语 a logical answer to the puzzle：1983 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件合乎逻辑的答案）
B. adj. 合乎逻辑／合理（两处加强说法：so logical that … 与 no less logical than …）
C. adj. 合乎逻辑／合理（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 合乎逻辑（表语 too logical to do：母亲觉得它太合乎逻辑，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 合理（前置定语 a logical reason for the rule：叔叔把整件事称作一桩合理的缘由）
F. adj. 合理（同级比较 as logical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那条规矩的合理缘由相比）
G. adj. 合理（后置定语 something logical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 合理（受程度副词修饰 quite logical：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a logical answer to the puzzle
the logical answer to the puzzle that
a logical reason for the rule
The logical reason for the rule that

answers.why: logical 意为“合乎逻辑”，1983 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件合乎逻辑的答案”，此处作前置定语 a logical answer to the puzzle。
logical 意为“合乎逻辑”，此处用 so logical that 结构，说它合乎逻辑到邮局里没人敢靠近。
logical 意为“合乎逻辑”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的合乎逻辑合乎逻辑的答案，等于最高级的说法。
logical 意为“合乎逻辑”，母亲认为这件东西“太合乎逻辑了，谁也用不上”，too logical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
logical 意为“合理”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩合理的缘由”，此处作前置定语 a logical reason for the rule。
logical 意为“合理”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那条规矩的合理缘由一样合理”，同级比较用 as logical as。
logical 意为“合理”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“合理的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something logical。
logical 意为“合理”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当合理”，quite 修饰原级 logical。
logical 意为“合理”，no less logical than 表示“其合理不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之合理不亚于任何人的预料。
logical 意为“合理”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的合理缘由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件合乎逻辑的答案。（a logical answer to the puzzle）
它合乎逻辑到邮局里没有一个人敢靠近。（so logical that …）
母亲觉得它太合乎逻辑，谁也用不上。（too logical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩合理的缘由。（a logical reason for the rule）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那条规矩的合理缘由一样合理。（as logical as …）
到了 1990 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件合理的东西。（something logical）
answers: In 1983 the postman wrote of a logical answer to the puzzle in the list.
It was so logical that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too logical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a logical reason for the rule.
He said nobody would call it as logical as the reason for the rule they had once had.
By 1990 the list asked for nothing but something logical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 logical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the postman wrote of a logical answer to the puzzle in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the logical answer to the puzzle that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too logical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a logical reason for the rule, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite logical, and everybody laughed.
The logical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
